mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.cover_image AS coverImage, a.synopsis, a.genres, a.release_date AS releaseDate, a.rating, a.episodes, a.status, COALESCE(ua.watch_status, 0) AS watchStatus FROM anime a LEFT JOIN user_anime ua ON a.id = ua.anime_id AND ua.user_id = #{userId} WHERE a.id = #{animeId}
